title: VFX probe (test-only)
author: mewgenics-mods
description: Test-only: (a) particles.gon.merge re-points the vanilla SparkleBuff system's movieclip to this mod's VfxProbeMarker clip (the _artprobe marker shape), (b) particles.gon.append adds a NEW system VfxProbeAura drawing this mod's VfxProbeDot clip (#ff0090), each worn by a Rat variant through the EliteParticle passive. npm run test:artprobe -- --vfx shoots and measures them. Never for play.
